Lessons: The World of the New Testament; The Four Gospels; Acts and the Spread of the Church; Paul's Letters to Churches; Paul's Letters to People; General Letters; Hebrews and Faith Under Pressure; Revelation and Final Hope
Description: Build on the Gospels by exploring how the good news travelled and took root. You will survey Acts, Paul's letters, the general letters and Revelation in their historical setting, seeing how each book answers real questions real churches faced. Expect clarity, context and plenty of encouragement.
KeyTopics: Church; Evangelism; Resurrection; Second Coming; Grace
RelatedBooks: Matthew; Acts; Romans; Galatians; Hebrews; Revelation
